<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Indicates whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Indicates whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Indicates whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Indicates whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input operand a.</assign>
        <assign id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input operand b.</assign>
        <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to store the result of the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="shift_amount" width_description="[4:0]">Shift amount for shift operations.</assign>
        <assign id="flag" width_description="[0:0]">Flag output for SLT and SLTU operations.</assign>
        <assign id="zero" width_description="[0:0]">Zero output indicating whether the result is zero.</assign>
        <assign id="carry" width_description="[0:0]">Carry output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="negative" width_description="[0:0]">Negative output indicating whether the result is negative.</assign>
        <assign id="overflow" width_description="[0:0]">Overflow output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</assign>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Assign input operands to signed wires
        assign signed_a = $signed(a);
        assign signed_b = $signed(b);
        
        // Assign output result to lower 32 bits of register res
        assign r = res[31:0];
        
        // Set flag output based on control signal aluc
        assign flag = (aluc == 6'b101010 || aluc == 6'b101011) ? 1 : 1'bz;
        
        // Set zero output based on result
        assign zero = (res == 32'h00000000) ? 1 : 0;
        
        // Always block triggered by changes in inputs a, b, or aluc
        always @(a, b, aluc) begin
            // Case statement based on control signal aluc
            case(aluc)
                // Arithmetic operations
                6'b100000: res <= signed_a + signed_b; // ADD
                6'b100001: res <= a + b; // ADDU
                6'b100010: res <= signed_a - signed_b; // SUB
                6'b100011: res <= a - b; // SUBU
                
                // Bitwise operations
                6'b100100: res <= a & b; // AND
                6'b100101: res <= a | b; // OR
                6'b100110: res <= a ^ b; // XOR
                6'b100111: res <= ~(a | b); // NOR
                
                // Comparison operations
                6'b101010: res <= ($signed(a) < $signed(b)) ? 1 : 0; // SLT
                6'b101011: res <= (a < b) ? 1 : 0; // SLTU
                
                // Shift operations
                6'b000000: res <= b << a[4:0]; // SLL
                6'b000010: res <= b >> a[4:0]; // SRL
                6'b000011: res <= $signed(b) >>> a[4:0]; // SRA
                6'b000100: res <= b << a[4:0]; // SLLV
                6'b000110: res <= b >> a[4:0]; // SRLV
                6'b000111: res <= $signed(b) >>> a[4:0]; // SRAV
                
                // Load Upper Immediate operation
                6'b001111: res <= {a[15:0], 16'h0000}; // LUI
                
                default: res <= 32'hzzzzzzzz; // Default case
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
    
</module>
